label: Late-episode GO after a common rewarded a2->S2 trial; strongest when the win is fresh.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (ep_trial >= 70) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == -1) * (belief_lo < 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 70) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1)
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (ep_trial >= 70) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == -1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (belief_lo < 0) * (ep_trial >= 70) ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 70) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (ep_trial >= 80) ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 70) * np.clip(-belief_lo, 0, 9) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (ep_trial >= 70) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 70) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == -1) * (ep_trial >= 70)
explanation: Fires only at GO and only late in the episode (trial >= ~70, which the timing baseline covers only additively). Its magnitude is set by the previous trial being a2 -> S2 (common) rewarded: after any other pattern (a1 trials, a2 unrewarded, a2 rare-rewarded) it is silent. Among such trials it is largest when the win is fresh, i.e. the trial before was not also rewarded (negative weight on tv(reward,-2)==1): activation decays across a streak of a2 S2 r wins (~0.8 -> 0.55). Many large values sit on the window first trial, where the previous trial is not in the data; there belief_lo < 0 (observer favours S2) stands in for it. The free fit adds the late-episode ramp (>=80 stronger), graded S2 belief, and the streak interaction. Short form test vs free fit roughly 2/3.
